translations.idiomatic: ' Now Chancellor Gao has issued this order—does my lord alone not pity the soldiers' deaths!

sentences.zh: 」眾共執之，不得引決。

translations.literal: " The crowd together seized him and he could not carry out his resolve.
translations.idiomatic: " The crowd together seized him and he could not carry out his resolve.

sentences.zh: 澄遣通直散騎趙彥深就土山遺以白羽扇，執手申意，牽之以下。

translations.literal: Cheng sent Direct Attendant Zhao Yanshen to the earthen hill with a white-feather fan as gift, took his hand to convey goodwill, and drew him down.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng sent Direct Attendant Zhao Yanshen to the earthen hill with a white-feather fan as gift, took his hand to convey goodwill, and drew him down.

sentences.zh: 澄不令拜，延而禮之。

translations.literal: Cheng did not require him to bow but received and honored him.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng did not require him to bow but received and honored him.

sentences.zh: 思政初入穎川，將士八千人，及城陷，才三千人，卒無叛者。

translations.literal: When Sizheng first entered Yingchuan he had eight thousand officers and soldiers; when the city fell there were only three thousand, yet in the end none rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: When Sizheng first entered Yingchuan he had eight thousand officers and soldiers; when the city fell there were only three thousand, yet in the end none rebelled.

sentences.zh: 澄悉散配其將卒於遠方，改穎川為鄭州，禮遇思政甚重。

translations.literal: Cheng dispersed and assigned all his officers and soldiers to distant places, renamed Yingchuan Zheng province, and treated Sizheng with great honor.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng dispersed and assigned all his officers and soldiers to distant places, renamed Yingchuan Zheng province, and treated Sizheng with great honor.

sentences.zh: 西閣祭酒盧潛曰：「思政不能死節，何足可重！

translations.literal: Western Pavilion Libationer Lu Qian said, "Sizheng could not die maintaining integrity—what is there to honor!
translations.idiomatic: Western Pavilion Libationer Lu Qian said, "Sizheng could not die maintaining integrity—what is there to honor!

sentences.zh: 」澄謂左右曰：「我有盧潛，乃是更得一王思政。

translations.literal: " Cheng told those around him, "With Lu Qian, I have gained another Wang Sizheng.
translations.idiomatic: " Cheng told those around him, "With Lu Qian, I have gained another Wang Sizheng.

sentences.zh: 」潛，度世之曾孫也。

translations.literal: " Qian was the great-grandson of Dushi.
translations.idiomatic: " Qian was the great-grandson of Dushi.

sentences.zh: 初，思政屯襄城，欲以長社為行台治所，遣使者魏仲啟陳於太師泰，並致書於淅州刺史崔猷。

translations.literal: Earlier, Sizheng had garrisoned Xiangcheng and wished to make Changshe the seat of the Mobile Headquarters; he sent envoy Wei Zhong to report to Grand Preceptor Tai and also wrote to Xi province Inspector Cui You.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, Sizheng had garrisoned Xiangcheng and wished to make Changshe the seat of the Mobile Headquarters; he sent envoy Wei Zhong to report to Grand Preceptor Yuwen Tai and also wrote to Xi province Inspector Cui You.

sentences.zh: 猷復書曰：「襄城控帶京、洛，實當今之要地，如有動靜，易相應接。

translations.literal: You replied, "Xiangcheng commands the approaches to Luoyang and is truly a vital place today; if there is any movement, response is easy.
translations.idiomatic: You replied, "Xiangcheng commands the approaches to Luoyang and is truly a vital place today; if there is any movement, response is easy.

sentences.zh: 穎川既鄰寇境，又無山川之固，賊若潛來，逕至城下。

translations.literal: Yingchuan borders enemy territory and lacks natural defenses; if the enemy comes secretly, he reaches the walls directly.
translations.idiomatic: Yingchuan borders enemy territory and lacks natural defenses; if the enemy comes secretly, he reaches the walls directly.

sentences.zh: 莫若頓兵襄城。

translations.literal: Better halt the army at Xiangcheng.
translations.idiomatic: Better halt the army at Xiangcheng.

sentences.zh: 為行台之所。

translations.literal: Make it the seat of the Mobile Headquarters.
translations.idiomatic: Make it the seat of the Mobile Headquarters.

sentences.zh: 穎川置州，遣良將鎮守，則表裡膠固，人心易安，縱有不虞，豈能為患！

translations.literal: Establish a province at Yingchuan and send a good general to garrison it—then inner and outer will be firmly joined, hearts will be easy to settle, and even if something unexpected occurs, how could it become a threat!
translations.idiomatic: Establish a province at Yingchuan and send a good general to garrison it—then inner and outer will be firmly joined, hearts will be easy to settle, and even if something unexpected occurs, how could it become a threat!

sentences.zh: 」仲見泰，具以啟聞。

translations.literal: " Zhong saw Tai and reported everything in full.
translations.idiomatic: " Zhong saw Tai and reported everything in full.

sentences.zh: 泰令依猷策。

translations.literal: Tai ordered that You's plan be followed.
translations.idiomatic: Tai ordered that You's plan be followed.

sentences.zh: 思政固請，且約：「賊水攻期年、陸攻三年之內，朝廷不煩赴救。

translations.literal: Sizheng firmly petitioned and moreover pledged, "Within one year of water attack or three years of land attack, the court need not trouble itself to send rescue.
translations.idiomatic: Sizheng firmly petitioned and moreover pledged, "Within one year of water attack or three years of land attack, the court need not trouble itself to send rescue.

sentences.zh: 」泰乃許之。

translations.literal: " Tai then consented.
translations.idiomatic: " Tai then consented.

sentences.zh: 及長社不守，泰深悔之。

translations.literal: When Changshe could not be held, Tai deeply regretted it.
translations.idiomatic: When Changshe fell, Tai deeply regretted it.

sentences.zh: 猷，孝芬之子也。

translations.literal: You was Xiaofen's son.
translations.idiomatic: You was Xiaofen's son.

sentences.zh: 侯景之南叛也，丞相泰恐東魏復取景所部地，使諸將分守諸城。

translations.literal: When Hou Jing rebelled southward, Chancellor Tai feared Eastern Wei would again take the territories Jing had held and had generals divide forces to guard the cities.
translations.idiomatic: When Hou Jing rebelled southward, Chancellor Yuwen Tai feared Eastern Wei would again take the territories Hou Jing had held and had generals divide forces to guard the cities.

sentences.zh: 及穎川陷，泰以諸城道路阻絕，皆令拔軍還。

translations.literal: When Yingchuan fell, Tai, seeing roads to the various cities cut off, ordered all armies withdrawn.
translations.idiomatic: When Yingchuan fell, Tai, seeing roads to the various cities cut off, ordered all armies withdrawn.

sentences.zh: 上甲侯韶自建康出奔江陵，稱受高祖密詔徵兵，以湘東王繹為侍中、假黃鉞、大都督中外諸軍事、司徒、承製，自餘籓鎮並加位號。

translations.literal: Hou Shao of Shangjia fled Jiankang for Jiangling, claiming he bore Gaozu's secret orders to raise troops; Prince Yi of Xiangdong was made Palace Attendant, granted the yellow battle-axe, Grand Commander of All Forces Inside and Outside, Minister of Education, and regent; the remaining princes and garrisons all received added titles.
translations.idiomatic: Hou Shao of Shangjia fled Jiankang for Jiangling, claiming he bore Emperor Wu's secret orders to raise troops; Prince Yi of Xiangdong was made Palace Attendant, granted the yellow battle-axe, Grand Commander of All Forces Inside and Outside, Minister of Education, and regent; the remaining princes and garrisons all received added titles.

sentences.zh: 宋子仙圍戴僧逖，不克。

translations.literal: Song Zixian besieged Dai Sengti but could not take him.
translations.idiomatic: Song Zixian besieged Dai Sengti but could not take him.

sentences.zh: 丙午，吳盜陸緝等起兵襲吳郡，殺蘇單于，推前淮南太守文成侯寧為主。

translations.literal: On bingwu, bandits of Wu led by Lu Ji and others rose, struck Wu commandery, killed Su Chanyu, and set up former Huainan Administrator Marquis Ning of Wencheng as leader.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, bandits of Wu led by Lu Ji and others rose, struck Wu commandery, killed Su Chanyu, and set up former Huainan Administrator Marquis Ning of Wencheng as leader.

sentences.zh: 臨賀王正德怨侯景賣己，密書召鄱陽王范，使以兵入；

translations.literal: Prince Zhengde of Linhe resented Hou Jing for betraying him and secretly wrote summoning Prince Fan of Poyang to enter with troops.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Zhengde of Linhe resented Hou Jing for betraying him and secretly wrote summoning Prince Fan of Poyang to enter with troops.

sentences.zh: 景遮得其書，癸丑，縊殺正德。

translations.literal: Jing intercepted the letter; on guichou he strangled Zhengde.
translations.idiomatic: Hou Jing intercepted the letter; on guichou he strangled Zhengde.

sentences.zh: 景以儀同三司郭元建為尚書僕射、北道行台、總江北諸軍事，鎮新秦；

translations.literal: Jing made Guo Yuanjian, Equal in Honor to the Three Dukes, Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, Northern Route Mobile Headquarters, overall commander of all military affairs north of the river, garrisoning Xinqin.
translations.idiomatic: Hou Jing made Guo Yuanjian, Equal in Honor to the Three Dukes, Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, Northern Route Mobile Headquarters, overall commander of all military affairs north of the river, garrisoning Xinqin.

sentences.zh: 封元羅等諸元十餘人皆為王。

translations.literal: More than ten members of the Yuan clan including Yuan Luo were all enfeoffed as princes.
translations.idiomatic: More than ten members of the Yuan clan including Yuan Luo were all enfeoffed as princes.

sentences.zh: 景愛永安侯確之勇，常置左右。

translations.literal: Jing admired the courage of Marquis Que of Yong'an and kept him always at his side.
translations.idiomatic: Hou Jing admired the courage of Marquis Que of Yong'an and kept him always at his side.

sentences.zh: 邵陵王綸潛遣人呼之，確曰：「景輕佻，一夫力耳，我欲手刃之，正恨未得其便，卿還啟家王，勿以確為念。

translations.literal: Prince Lun of Shaoling secretly sent someone to summon him; Que said, "Jing is frivolous—a single man's strength; I wish to kill him with my own hand and only regret I have not yet found the chance; return and report to my house's prince, and do not worry about Que.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Lun of Shaoling secretly sent someone to summon him; Que said, "Hou Jing is frivolous—a single man's strength; I wish to kill him with my own hand and only regret I have not yet found the chance; return and report to my prince, and do not worry about me.

sentences.zh: 」景與確游鐘山，引弓射鳥，因欲射景，弦斷，不發，景覺而殺之。

translations.literal: " Jing went with Que to roam Zhong Mountain, drew bow to shoot birds, then meant to shoot Jing; the string snapped and would not release; Jing noticed and killed him.
translations.idiomatic: " Hou Jing went with Que to roam Zhong Mountain, drew bow to shoot birds, then meant to shoot Hou Jing; the string snapped and would not release; Hou Jing noticed and killed him.

sentences.zh: 湘東王繹娶徐孝嗣孫女為妃，生世子方等。

translations.literal: Prince Yi of Xiangdong married a granddaughter of Xu Xiaosi as consort and begot the heir Fangdeng.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Yi of Xiangdong married a granddaughter of Xu Xiaosi as consort and begot the heir Fangdeng.

sentences.zh: 妃丑而妒，又多失行，繹二三年一至其室。

translations.literal: The consort was ugly and jealous and had many moral failings; Yi visited her chamber once every two or three years.
translations.idiomatic: The consort was ugly and jealous and had many moral failings; Yi visited her chamber once every two or three years.

sentences.zh: 妃聞繹當至，以繹目眇，為半面妝以待之，繹怒而出，故方等亦無寵。

translations.literal: When the consort heard Yi was coming, knowing Yi was blind in one eye, she made up only half her face to receive him; Yi left in anger, and so Fangdeng also had no favor.
translations.idiomatic: When the consort heard Yi was coming, knowing Yi was blind in one eye, she made up only half her face to receive him; Yi left in anger, and so Fangdeng also had no favor.

sentences.zh: 及自建康還江陵，繹見其御軍和整，始歎其能，入告徐妃，妃不對，垂泣而退。

translations.literal: When he returned from Jiankang to Jiangling, Yi saw Fangdeng's command of troops was orderly and disciplined and began to admire his ability; he went in and told Consort Xu; she did not answer but withdrew weeping.
translations.idiomatic: When he returned from Jiankang to Jiangling, Yi saw Fangdeng's command of troops was orderly and disciplined and began to admire his ability; he went in and told Consort Xu; she did not answer but withdrew weeping.

sentences.zh: 繹怒，疏其穢行，榜於大閤，方等見之，益懼。

translations.literal: Yi was angered, listed her disgraceful conduct, and posted it on the great gate; Fangdeng saw it and grew still more afraid.
translations.idiomatic: Yi was angered, listed her disgraceful conduct, and posted it on the great gate; Fangdeng saw it and grew still more afraid.

sentences.zh: 湘州刺史河東王譽，驍勇得士心，繹將討侯景，遣使督其糧眾，譽曰：「各自軍府，何忽隸人！

translations.literal: Xiangzhou Inspector Prince Yu of Hedong was fierce and brave and won soldiers' hearts; as Yi was about to campaign against Hou Jing he sent an envoy to command his grain and troops; Yu said, "Each has his own headquarters—why suddenly become someone else's subordinate!
translations.idiomatic: Xiangzhou Inspector Prince Yu of Hedong was fierce and brave and won soldiers' hearts; as Yi was about to campaign against Hou Jing he sent an envoy to command his grain and troops; Yu said, "Each has his own headquarters—why suddenly become someone else's subordinate!

sentences.zh: 」使者三返，譽不與。

translations.literal: " The envoy returned three times; Yu would not comply.
translations.idiomatic: " The envoy returned three times; Yu would not comply.

sentences.zh: 方等請討之，繹乃以少子安南侯方矩為湘州刺史，使方等將精卒二萬送之。

translations.literal: Fangdeng asked to campaign against him; Yi then made his youngest son Marquis Fangju of Annan Inspector of Xiangzhou and sent Fangdeng with twenty thousand elite troops to escort him.
translations.idiomatic: Fangdeng asked to campaign against him; Yi then made his youngest son Marquis Fangju of Annan Inspector of Xiangzhou and sent Fangdeng with twenty thousand elite troops to escort him.

sentences.zh: 方等將行，謂所親曰：「是行也，吾必死之；

translations.literal: As Fangdeng was about to depart, he told those close to him, "On this journey I am sure to die;
translations.idiomatic: As Fangdeng was about to depart, he told those close to him, "On this journey I am sure to die;

sentences.zh: 死得其所，吾復奚恨！

translations.literal: dying in the right place—what more would I regret!
translations.idiomatic: dying in the right place—what more would I regret!

sentences.zh: 侯景以趙威方為豫章太守，江州刺史尋陽王大心遣軍拒之，擒威方，系州獄，威方逃還建康。

translations.literal: Hou Jing made Zhao Weifang Administrator of Yuzhang; Jiangzhou Inspector Prince Daxin of Xunyang sent troops to resist, captured Weifang, and imprisoned him in the provincial jail; Weifang escaped back to Jiankang.
translations.idiomatic: Hou Jing made Zhao Weifang Administrator of Yuzhang; Jiangzhou Inspector Prince Daxin of Xunyang sent troops to resist, captured Weifang, and imprisoned him in the provincial jail; Weifang escaped back to Jiankang.

sentences.zh: 湘東世子方等軍至麻溪，河東王譽將七千人擊之，方等軍敗，溺死。

translations.literal: The Xiangdong heir Fangdeng's army reached Maxi; Prince Yu of Hedong with seven thousand men struck; Fangdeng's army was defeated and he drowned.
translations.idiomatic: The Xiangdong heir Fangdeng's army reached Maxi; Prince Yu of Hedong with seven thousand men struck; Fangdeng's army was defeated and he drowned.

sentences.zh: 安南侯方矩收餘眾還江陵，湘東王繹無戚容。

translations.literal: Marquis Fangju of Annan gathered the survivors and returned to Jiangling; Prince Yi of Xiangdong showed no grief.
translations.idiomatic: Marquis Fangju of Annan gathered the survivors and returned to Jiangling; Prince Yi of Xiangdong showed no grief.

sentences.zh: 繹寵姬王氏，生子方諸。

translations.literal: Yi favored concubine Lady Wang, who bore Fangzhu.
translations.idiomatic: Yi favored concubine Lady Wang, who bore Fangzhu.

sentences.zh: 王氏卒，繹疑徐妃為之，逼令自殺，妃赴井死，葬以庶人禮，不聽諸子制服。

translations.literal: When Wang died, Yi suspected Consort Xu had done it, forced her to kill herself; the consort threw herself into a well and died; she was buried with commoner rites and her sons were forbidden mourning dress.
translations.idiomatic: When Wang died, Yi suspected Consort Xu had done it and forced her to kill herself; the consort threw herself into a well and died; she was buried with commoner rites and her sons were forbidden mourning dress.

sentences.zh: 西江督護陳霸先欲起兵討侯景，景使人誘廣州刺史元景仲，許奉以為主，景仲由是附景，陰圖霸先。

translations.literal: West River Protector Chen Baxian wished to raise troops against Hou Jing; Jing sent men to entice Guangzhou Inspector Yuan Jingzhong, promising to make him ruler; Jingzhong therefore joined Jing and secretly plotted against Baxian.
translations.idiomatic: West River Protector Chen Baxian wished to raise troops against Hou Jing; Hou Jing sent men to entice Guangzhou Inspector Yuan Jingzhong, promising to make him ruler; Jingzhong therefore joined Hou Jing and secretly plotted against Baxian.

sentences.zh: 霸先知之，與成州刺史王懷明等集兵南海，馳檄以討景仲曰：「元景仲與賊合從，朝廷遣曲陽侯勃為刺史，軍已頓朝亭。

translations.literal: Baxian learned of it; with Chengzhou Inspector Wang Huaiming and others he gathered troops at Nanhai and issued a rapid proclamation against Jingzhong, saying, "Yuan Jingzhong has joined the rebels; the court has sent Marquis Bo of Quyang as inspector and the army has already encamped at Chaoting.
translations.idiomatic: Baxian learned of it; with Chengzhou Inspector Wang Huaiming and others he gathered troops at Nanhai and issued a rapid proclamation against Jingzhong: "Yuan Jingzhong has joined the rebels; the court has sent Marquis Bo of Quyang as inspector and the army has already encamped at Chaoting.

sentences.zh: 」景仲所部聞之，皆棄景仲而散。

translations.literal: " Jingzhong's followers, hearing this, all abandoned him and dispersed.
translations.idiomatic: " Jingzhong's followers, hearing this, all abandoned him and dispersed.

sentences.zh: 秋，七月，甲寅，景仲縊於閣下。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on jiayin, Jingzhong hanged himself beneath the pavilion.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, the seventh month, on jiayin, Jingzhong hanged himself beneath the pavilion.

sentences.zh: 霸先迎定州刺史蕭勃鎮廣州。

translations.literal: Baxian welcomed Dingzhou Inspector Xiao Bo to garrison Guangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Baxian welcomed Dingzhou Inspector Xiao Bo to garrison Guangzhou.

sentences.zh: 前高州刺史蘭裕，欽之弟也，與其諸弟扇誘始興等十郡，攻監衡州事歐陽頠。

translations.literal: Former Gaozhou Inspector Lan Yu, Qin's younger brother, with his brothers incited Shixing and nine other commanderies and attacked Ouyang Yu, who supervised Hengzhou affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Former Gaozhou Inspector Lan Yu, Qin's younger brother, with his brothers incited Shixing and nine other commanderies and attacked Ouyang Yu, who supervised Hengzhou affairs.

sentences.zh: 勃使霸先救之，悉擒裕等，勃因以霸先監始興郡事。

translations.literal: Bo sent Baxian to the rescue; Yu and the others were all captured; Bo therefore made Baxian supervisor of Shixing commandery affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Bo sent Baxian to the rescue; Yu and the others were all captured; Bo therefore made Baxian supervisor of Shixing commandery affairs.

sentences.zh: 湘東王繹遣竟陵太守王僧辯、信州刺史東海鮑泉擊湘州，分給兵糧，刻日就道。

translations.literal: Prince Yi of Xiangdong sent Jingling Administrator Wang Senbian and Xin province Inspector Bao Quan of Donghai to attack Xiangzhou, allotting troops and grain with a fixed day for departure.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Yi of Xiangdong sent Jingling Administrator Wang Senbian and Xin province Inspector Bao Quan of Donghai to attack Xiangzhou, allotting troops and grain with a fixed day for departure.

sentences.zh: 僧辯以竟陵部下未盡至，欲俟眾集然後行，與泉入白繹，求申期日。

translations.literal: Senbian, because his Jingling troops had not all arrived, wished to wait until the force was assembled before marching; he and Quan entered to report to Yi and asked to extend the deadline.
translations.idiomatic: Senbian, because his Jingling troops had not all arrived, wished to wait until the force was assembled before marching; he and Quan entered to report to Yi and asked to extend the deadline.

sentences.zh: 繹疑僧辯觀望，按劍厲聲曰：「卿憚行拒命，欲同賊邪？

translations.literal: Yi suspected Senbian was hesitating; he grasped his sword and said in a harsh voice, "You fear marching and refuse orders—do you wish to join the rebels?
translations.idiomatic: Yi suspected Senbian was hesitating; he grasped his sword and said in a harsh voice, "You fear marching and refuse orders—do you wish to join the rebels?

sentences.zh: 今日唯有死耳！

translations.literal: Today there is only death!
translations.idiomatic: Today there is only death!

sentences.zh: 」因斫僧辯，中其左髀，悶絕，久之方蘇，即送獄。

translations.literal: " He then struck at Senbian, hitting his left thigh; Senbian fainted and only after long time revived; he was sent at once to prison.
translations.idiomatic: " He then struck at Senbian, hitting his left thigh; Senbian fainted and only after a long time revived; he was sent at once to prison.

sentences.zh: 泉震怖，不敢言。

translations.literal: Quan was shaken with terror and dared not speak.
translations.idiomatic: Quan was shaken with terror and dared not speak.

sentences.zh: 僧辯母徒行流涕入謝，自陳無訓，繹意解，賜以良藥，故得不死。

translations.literal: Senbian's mother walked in on foot weeping to apologize, confessing she had failed in training; Yi's anger eased; he granted good medicine, and so Senbian did not die.
translations.idiomatic: Senbian's mother walked in on foot weeping to apologize, confessing she had failed in training; Yi's anger eased; he granted good medicine, and so Senbian did not die.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，鮑泉獨將兵伐湘州。

translations.literal: On dingmao, Bao Quan alone led troops to campaign against Xiangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, Bao Quan alone led troops to campaign against Xiangzhou.

sentences.zh: 陸輯等競為暴掠，吳人不附，宋子仙自錢塘旋軍擊之。

translations.literal: Lu Ji and the others competed in violent plunder; the people of Wu would not follow them; Song Zixian turned his army from Qiantang to strike them.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Ji and the others competed in violent plunder; the people of Wu would not follow them; Song Zixian turned his army from Qiantang to strike them.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，緝棄城奔海鹽，子仙復據吳郡。

translations.literal: On renxu, Ji abandoned the city and fled to Haiyan; Zixian again held Wu commandery.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, Ji abandoned the city and fled to Haiyan; Zixian again held Wu commandery.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，侯景置吳州於吳郡，以安陸王大春為刺史。

translations.literal: On wuchen, Hou Jing established Wu province in Wu commandery and made Prince Dachun of Anlu its inspector.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, Hou Jing established Wu province in Wu commandery and made Prince Dachun of Anlu its inspector.

sentences.zh: 庚午，以南康王會理兼尚書令。

translations.literal: On gengwu, Prince Huili of Nankang was additionally made Director of the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, Prince Huili of Nankang was additionally made Director of the Masters of Writing.

sentences.zh: 鄱陽王范聞建康不守，戒嚴，欲入，僚佐或說之曰：「今魏人已據壽陽，大王移足，則虜騎必窺合肥。

translations.literal: Prince Fan of Poyang, hearing Jiankang had not held, ordered martial law and intended to enter; some staff urged him, saying, "The Wei men now hold Shouyang; if Your Highness moves a step, enemy cavalry will surely watch Hefei.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Fan of Poyang, hearing Jiankang had fallen, ordered martial law and intended to march in; some staff urged him: "The Wei men now hold Shouyang; if Your Highness moves a step, enemy cavalry will surely watch Hefei.

sentences.zh: 前賊未平，後城失守，將若之何！

translations.literal: The rebels in front are not yet pacified; the city behind may be lost—what then!
translations.idiomatic: The rebels in front are not yet pacified; the city behind may be lost—what then!

sentences.zh: 不如待四方兵集，使良將將精卒赴之，進不失勤王，退可固本根。

translations.literal: Better wait until troops from the four quarters assemble, send a good general with elite soldiers to the rescue—advancing you will not fail in saving the throne, retreating you can secure your base.
translations.idiomatic: Better wait until troops from the four quarters assemble, send a good general with elite soldiers to the rescue—advancing you will not fail in saving the throne, retreating you can secure your base.

sentences.zh: 」范乃止。

translations.literal: " Fan then stopped.
translations.idiomatic: " Fan then abandoned the plan.

sentences.zh: 會東魏大將軍澄遣西兗州刺史李伯穆逼合肥，又使魏收為書諭范。

translations.literal: Just then Eastern Wei Grand General Cheng sent Western Yanzhou Inspector Li Bomu to press Hefei, and also had Wei Shou write a letter to instruct Fan.
translations.idiomatic: Just then Eastern Wei grand general Gao Cheng sent Western Yanzhou inspector Li Bomu to press Hefei, and also had Wei Shou write to counsel Fan.

sentences.zh: 范方謀討侯景，藉東魏為援，乃帥戰士二萬出東關，以合州輸伯穆，並遣咨議劉靈議送二子勤、廣為質於東魏以乞師。

translations.literal: Fan was then plotting to attack Hou Jing and sought Eastern Wei as aid; he led twenty thousand warriors out through Dongguan, supplied Bomu from the whole province, and sent advisory staff officer Liu Lingyi to deliver his two sons Qin and Guang as hostages to Eastern Wei to beg for troops.
translations.idiomatic: Fan was plotting to attack Hou Jing and sought Eastern Wei as ally; he led twenty thousand warriors out through Dongguan, supplied Bomu from the whole province, and sent advisory staff officer Liu Lingyi to deliver his sons Qin and Guang as hostages to Eastern Wei to beg for troops.

sentences.zh: 范屯濡須以待上游之軍，遣世子嗣將千餘人守安樂柵，上遊軍皆不下，范糧乏，采菰稗、菱藕以自給。

translations.literal: Fan encamped at Ruxu to await upstream armies, sent his heir Si with more than a thousand men to hold Anle stockade; upstream armies all did not come down; Fan's grain ran short, and he gathered wild rice, water chestnuts, and lotus roots to sustain himself.
translations.idiomatic: Fan encamped at Ruxu to await upstream armies and sent his heir Si with more than a thousand men to hold Anle stockade; upstream armies never came down. Fan's grain ran short, and he gathered wild rice, water chestnuts, and lotus roots to sustain himself.

sentences.zh: 勤、廣至鄴，東魏人竟不為出師。

translations.literal: Qin and Guang reached Ye, but the Eastern Wei men would not send troops after all.
translations.idiomatic: Qin and Guang reached Ye, but the Eastern Wei court would not send troops after all.

sentences.zh: 范進退無計，乃溯流西上，軍於樅陽。

translations.literal: Fan had no plan whether to advance or retreat; he then went upstream westward and encamped at Zongyang.
translations.idiomatic: Fan, caught with no way forward or back, went upstream westward and encamped at Zongyang.

sentences.zh: 景出屯姑孰，范將裴之悌以眾降之。

translations.literal: Jing went out and encamped at Gudu; Fan's general Pei Zhiti surrendered with his troops.
translations.idiomatic: Jing marched out and encamped at Gudu; Fan's general Pei Zhiti surrendered with his troops.

sentences.zh: 之悌，之高之弟也。

translations.literal: Zhiti was Zhigao's younger brother.
translations.idiomatic: Zhiti was the younger brother of Pei Zhigao.

sentences.zh: 東魏大將軍澄詣鄴，辭爵位殊禮，且請立太子。

translations.literal: Eastern Wei Grand General Cheng went to Ye, declined special honors of rank, and also asked that a crown prince be installed.
translations.idiomatic: Eastern Wei grand general Gao Cheng went to Ye, declined special honors of rank, and also asked that a crown prince be installed.

sentences.zh: 澄謂濟陰王暉業曰：「比讀何書？

translations.literal: Cheng said to Prince of Jiyin Huiye, "What books have you been reading lately?
translations.idiomatic: Cheng said to Prince Huiye of Jiyin, "What books have you been reading lately?

sentences.zh: 」暉業曰：「數尋伊、霍之傳，不讀曹、馬之書。

translations.literal: " Huiye said, "I often seek the records of Yi Yin and Huo Guang; I do not read the books of Cao and Sima.
translations.idiomatic: " Huiye said, "I often study the records of Yi Yin and Huo Guang; I do not read the books of Cao and Sima."

sentences.zh: 八月，甲申朔，侯景遣其中軍都督侯子鑒等擊吳興。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the first day jiashen, Hou Jing sent his Central Army Commander Hou Zijian and others to attack Wuxing.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the first day jiashen, Hou Jing sent his central army commander Hou Zijian and others to attack Wuxing.

sentences.zh: 己亥，鮑泉軍於石槨寺，河東王譽逆戰而敗；

translations.literal: On jihai, Bao Quan encamped at Shiguosi; Prince of Hedong Yu met him in battle and was defeated;
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, Bao Quan encamped at Shiguosi; Prince Xiao Yu of Hedong met him in battle and was defeated;

sentences.zh: 辛丑，又敗於橘洲，戰及溺死者萬餘人。

translations.literal: on xinchou, he was defeated again at Juzhou; those killed in battle and drowned numbered more than ten thousand.
translations.idiomatic: on xinchou he was defeated again at Juzhou; more than ten thousand were killed in battle or drowned.

sentences.zh: 譽退保長沙，泉引軍圍之。

translations.literal: Yu withdrew to hold Changsha; Quan led his army to besiege it.
translations.idiomatic: Yu withdrew to hold Changsha; Quan led his army to besiege it.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，東魏立皇子長仁為太子。

translations.literal: On xinmao, Eastern Wei installed the emperor's son Changren as crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, Eastern Wei installed the emperor's son Changren as crown prince.

sentences.zh: 勃海文襄王高澄以其弟太原公洋次長，意常忌之。

translations.literal: Prince Wenxiang of Bohai, Gao Cheng, because his younger brother Prince of Taiyuan Yang was next in age, often harbored suspicion of him.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Wenxiang of Bohai, Gao Cheng, because his younger brother Prince Yang of Taiyuan was next in age, often harbored suspicion of him.

sentences.zh: 洋深自晦匿，言不出口，常自貶退，與澄言，無不順從。

translations.literal: Yang deeply concealed himself, rarely speaking; he constantly belittled himself, and in speaking with Cheng never failed to obey.
translations.idiomatic: Yang kept himself deeply concealed, rarely speaking; he constantly belittled himself, and in speaking with Cheng never failed to obey.

sentences.zh: 澄輕之，常曰：「此人亦得富貴，相書亦何可解！

translations.literal: Cheng looked down on him and often said, "This man can also attain wealth and rank—what can physiognomy books explain!
translations.idiomatic: Cheng looked down on him and often said, "This man can also attain wealth and rank—what can physiognomy books explain!

sentences.zh: 」洋為其夫人趙郡李氏營服玩小佳，澄輒奪取之；

translations.literal: " Yang had made some fine clothes and ornaments for his wife, Lady Li of Zhao Commandery; Cheng would seize them;
translations.idiomatic: " Yang had made some fine clothes and ornaments for his wife, Lady Li of Zhao Commandery; Cheng would seize them;

sentences.zh: 夫人或恚未與，洋笑曰：「此物猶應可求，兄須何容吝惜！

translations.literal: when his wife was angry and withheld them, Yang smiled and said, "These things can still be sought again—why should elder brother be so stingy!
translations.idiomatic: when his wife was angry and withheld them, Yang smiled and said, "These things can still be sought again—why should elder brother be so stingy!

sentences.zh: 」澄或愧不取，洋即受之，亦無飾讓。

translations.literal: " Cheng sometimes, ashamed, did not take them; Yang then accepted them without pretense of refusal.
translations.idiomatic: " Cheng sometimes, ashamed, did not take them; Yang then accepted them without pretense of refusal.

sentences.zh: 每退朝還第，輒閉閣靜坐，雖對妻子，能竟日不言。

translations.literal: Whenever he returned from court to his residence, he would shut his doors and sit in silence; even before wife and children he could pass a whole day without speaking.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever he returned from court to his residence, he shut his doors and sat in silence; even before wife and children he could pass a whole day without speaking.

sentences.zh: 或時袒跣奔躍，夫人問其故，洋曰：「為爾漫戲。

translations.literal: Sometimes he would run and leap barefoot; when his wife asked why, Yang said, "Just playing around with you.
translations.idiomatic: Sometimes he ran and leaped barefoot; when his wife asked why, Yang said, "Just playing around with you.

sentences.zh: 」其實蓋欲習勞也。

translations.literal: " In truth he was training himself to endure hardship.
translations.idiomatic: " In truth he was training himself to endure hardship.

sentences.zh: 澄獲徐州刺史蘭欽子京，以為膳奴，欽請贖之，不許；

translations.literal: Cheng captured Lan Qin's son Jing, son of Xuzhou Inspector Lan Qin, and made him a kitchen slave; Qin asked to ransom him and was refused;
translations.idiomatic: Cheng captured Lan Jing, son of Xuzhou inspector Lan Qin, and made him a kitchen slave; Qin asked to ransom him and was refused;

sentences.zh: 京屢自訴，澄杖之，曰：「更訴，當殺汝！

translations.literal: Jing repeatedly pleaded for himself; Cheng beat him and said, "Plead again and I will kill you!
translations.idiomatic: Jing repeatedly pleaded for himself; Cheng beat him and said, "Plead again and I will kill you!

sentences.zh: 」京與其黨六人謀作亂。

translations.literal: " Jing and six of his companions plotted rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: " Jing and six of his companions plotted rebellion.

sentences.zh: 澄在鄴，居北城東柏堂，嬖琅邪公主，欲其往來無間，侍衛者常遣出外。

translations.literal: Cheng was at Ye, dwelling in the Eastern Cypress Hall of the north city; he favored the Princess of Langye and wished her comings and goings to be unhindered, so he often sent the guards outside.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng was at Ye, dwelling in the Eastern Cypress Hall of the north city; he favored the Princess of Langye and wished her comings and goings to be unhindered, so he often sent the guards outside.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，澄與散騎常侍陳元康、吏部尚書侍中楊愔、黃門侍郎崔季舒屏左右，謀受魏禪，署擬百官。

translations.literal: On xinmao, Cheng, with Supernumerary Cavalier Attendant Chen Yuankang, Minister of Personnel and Attendant-in-Ordinary Yang Yin, and Yellow Gate Gentleman Cui Jishu, dismissed attendants and plotted to receive Wei abdication, drafting appointments for the hundred offices.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, Cheng, with supernumerary cavalier attendant Chen Yuankang, minister of personnel and attendant-in-ordinary Yang Yin, and yellow gate gentleman Cui Jishu, dismissed attendants and plotted to receive Wei abdication, drafting appointments for the hundred offices.

sentences.zh: 蘭京進食，澄卻之，謂諸人曰：「昨夜夢此奴斫我，當急殺之。

translations.literal: Lan Jing brought food; Cheng refused it and said to the others, "Last night I dreamed this slave hacked me—I must kill him at once.
translations.idiomatic: Lan Jing brought food; Cheng refused it and said to the others, "Last night I dreamed this slave hacked me—I must kill him at once.

sentences.zh: 」京聞之，置刀盤下，冒言進食。

translations.literal: " Jing heard this, hid a knife under the tray, and forced his way in claiming to serve food.
translations.idiomatic: " Jing heard this, hid a knife under the tray, and forced his way in claiming to serve food.

sentences.zh: 澄怒曰：「我未索食，何為遽來！

translations.literal: Cheng angrily said, "I did not ask for food—why come so suddenly!
translations.idiomatic: Cheng angrily said, "I did not ask for food—why come so suddenly!

sentences.zh: 」京揮刀曰：「來殺汝！

translations.literal: " Jing swung the knife and said, "I have come to kill you!
translations.idiomatic: " Jing swung the knife and said, "I have come to kill you!

sentences.zh: 」澄自投傷足，入於床下，賊去床，弒之。

translations.literal: " Cheng threw himself down, injuring his foot, and crawled under the bed; the assassins lifted the bed and killed him.
translations.idiomatic: " Cheng threw himself down, injuring his foot, and crawled under the bed; the assassins lifted the bed and killed him.

sentences.zh: 愔狼狽走出，遺一靴；

translations.literal: Yin fled in disarray, leaving one boot behind;
translations.idiomatic: Yin fled in disarray, leaving one boot behind;

sentences.zh: 季舒匿於廁中；

translations.literal: Jishu hid in the privy;
translations.idiomatic: Jishu hid in the privy;

sentences.zh: 元康以身蔽澄，與賊爭刀被傷，腸出；

translations.literal: Yuankang shielded Cheng with his body, struggled with the assassins for the blade, was wounded, and his intestines spilled out;
translations.idiomatic: Yuankang shielded Cheng with his body, struggled with the assassins for the blade, was wounded, and his intestines spilled out;

sentences.zh: 庫直王紘冒刃御賊；

translations.literal: Storehouse officer Wang Hong braved the blades to repel the assassins;
translations.idiomatic: Storehouse officer Wang Hong braved the blades to repel the assassins;

sentences.zh: 紇奚捨樂斗死。

translations.literal: Hong and Xi Shele fought and died.
translations.idiomatic: Hong and Xi Shele fought and died.

sentences.zh: 時變起倉猝，內外震駭。

translations.literal: The crisis arose in sudden haste; inside and outside were shaken with terror.
translations.idiomatic: The crisis arose in sudden haste; inside and outside were shaken with terror.

sentences.zh: 太原公洋在城東雙堂，聞之，神色不變，指揮部分，入討群賊，斬而臠之，徐出，言曰：「奴反，大將軍被傷，無大苦也。

translations.literal: Prince of Taiyuan Yang was in the Twin Hall east of the city; hearing of it, his expression did not change. He directed deployment, entered to suppress the assassins, cut them down and minced them, then came out slowly and said, "The slaves rebelled; the Grand General was wounded—nothing serious.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Yang of Taiyuan was in the Twin Hall east of the city; hearing of it, his expression did not change. He directed deployment, entered to suppress the assassins, cut them down and minced them, then came out slowly and said, "The slaves rebelled; the grand general was wounded—nothing serious.

sentences.zh: 」內外莫不驚異。

translations.literal: " Inside and outside, none were not astonished.
translations.idiomatic: " Inside and outside, all were astonished.

sentences.zh: 洋秘不發喪。

translations.literal: Yang kept the death secret and did not announce mourning.
translations.idiomatic: Yang kept the death secret and did not announce mourning.

sentences.zh: 陳元康手書辭母，口占使功曹參軍祖珽作書陳便宜，至夜而卒；

translations.literal: Chen Yuankang wrote by hand a farewell to his mother and dictated for staff officer Zu Ting a memorial setting forth urgent measures; by night he died;
translations.idiomatic: Chen Yuankang wrote by hand a farewell to his mother and dictated for staff officer Zu Ting a memorial setting forth urgent measures; by night he died;

sentences.zh: 洋殯之第中，詐雲出使，虛除元康中書令。

translations.literal: Yang laid him out in the residence, falsely saying he had gone on mission, and posthumously appointed Yuankang Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Yang laid him out in the residence, falsely saying he had gone on mission, and posthumously appointed Yuankang director of the secretariat.

sentences.zh: 以王紘為領左右都督。

translations.literal: He made Wang Hong Commander of the Left and Right Guards.
translations.idiomatic: He made Wang Hong commander of the left and right guards.

sentences.zh: 紘，基之子也。

translations.literal: Hong was Ji's son.
translations.idiomatic: Hong was the son of Wang Ji.

sentences.zh: 勳貴以重兵皆在并州，勸洋早如晉陽，洋從之。

translations.literal: The meritorious nobles, because the heavy troops were all at Bingzhou, urged Yang to go quickly to Jinyang; Yang agreed.
translations.idiomatic: The meritorious nobles, because the heavy troops were all at Bingzhou, urged Yang to go quickly to Jinyang; Yang agreed.

sentences.zh: 夜，召大將軍督護太原唐邕，使部分將士，鎮遏四方；

translations.literal: At night he summoned Grand General Protector of Taiyuan Tang Yong and had him deploy officers and soldiers to secure and suppress all quarters;
translations.idiomatic: At night he summoned grand general protector of Taiyuan Tang Yong and had him deploy officers and soldiers to secure all quarters;

sentences.zh: 邕支配須臾而畢，洋由是重之。

translations.literal: Yong completed the deployment in a moment; Yang therefore valued him highly.
translations.idiomatic: Yong completed the deployment in a moment; Yang therefore valued him highly.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，洋諷東魏主以立太子大赦。

translations.literal: On guisi, Yang prompted the Eastern Wei emperor to proclaim a general amnesty for installing the crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, Yang prompted the Eastern Wei emperor to proclaim a general amnesty for installing the crown prince.

sentences.zh: 澄死問漸露，東魏主竊謂左右曰：「大將軍今死，似是天意，威權當復歸帝室矣！

translations.literal: News of Cheng's death gradually leaked out; the Eastern Wei emperor secretly said to those around him, "The Grand General is dead now—it seems heaven's will; authority should return to the imperial house!
translations.idiomatic: News of Cheng's death gradually leaked out; the Eastern Wei emperor secretly said to those around him, "The grand general is dead now—it seems heaven's will; authority should return to the imperial house!

sentences.zh: 」洋留太尉高岳、太保高隆之、開府儀同三司司馬子如、侍中楊愔守鄴，餘勳貴皆自隨。

translations.literal: " Yang left Grand Commandant Gao Yue, Grand Guardian Gao Longzhi, Equal in Honor to the Three Dukes Sima Ziru, and Attendant-in-Ordinary Yang Yin to hold Ye; the rest of the meritorious nobles all followed him.
translations.idiomatic: " Yang left grand commandant Gao Yue, grand guardian Gao Longzhi, equal in honor to the three dukes Sima Ziru, and attendant-in-ordinary Yang Yin to hold Ye; the rest of the meritorious nobles all followed him.

sentences.zh: 甲午，入謁東魏主於昭陽殿，從甲士八千人，登階者二百餘人，皆攘袂扣刃，若對嚴敵。

translations.literal: On jiawu, he entered to pay homage to the Eastern Wei emperor at Zhaoyang Hall with eight thousand armored soldiers; more than two hundred who ascended the steps all rolled up their sleeves and gripped their blades, as if facing a formidable foe.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, he entered to pay homage to the Eastern Wei emperor at Zhaoyang Hall with eight thousand armored soldiers; more than two hundred who ascended the steps all rolled up their sleeves and gripped their blades, as if facing a formidable foe.

sentences.zh: 令主者傳奏曰：「臣有家事，須詣晉陽。

translations.literal: He had the usher transmit the memorial: "Your servant has family business and must go to Jinyang.
translations.idiomatic: He had the usher transmit the memorial: "Your servant has family business and must go to Jinyang.

sentences.zh: 」再拜而出。

translations.literal: " He bowed twice and withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: " He bowed twice and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 東魏主失色，目送之曰：「此人又似不相容，朕不知死在何日！

translations.literal: The Eastern Wei emperor turned pale; watching him go he said, "This man again seems incompatible with me—I know not on what day I shall die!
translations.idiomatic: The Eastern Wei emperor turned pale; watching him go he said, "This man again seems incompatible with me—I know not on what day I shall die!

sentences.zh: 」晉陽舊臣宿將素輕洋；

translations.literal: " The old ministers and veteran generals of Jinyang had always looked down on Yang;
translations.idiomatic: " The old ministers and veteran generals of Jinyang had always looked down on Yang;

sentences.zh: 及至，大會文武，神彩英暢，言辭敏洽，眾皆大驚。

translations.literal: when he arrived, he held a great assembly of civil and military officials; his spirit was bright and fluent, his words quick and apt—all were greatly astonished.
translations.idiomatic: when he arrived, he held a great assembly of civil and military officials; his spirit was bright and fluent, his words quick and apt—all were greatly astonished.

sentences.zh: 澄政令有不便者，洋皆改之。

translations.literal: Where Cheng's policies and orders had been inconvenient, Yang changed them all.
translations.idiomatic: Where Cheng's policies and orders had been inconvenient, Yang changed them all.

sentences.zh: 高隆之、司馬子如等惡度支尚書崔暹，奏暹及崔季舒過惡，鞭二百，徙邊。

translations.literal: Gao Longzhi, Sima Ziru, and others hated Revenue Minister Cui Xian; they memorialized Xian and Cui Jishu's faults and crimes—two hundred lashes and exile to the frontier.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Longzhi, Sima Ziru, and others hated revenue minister Cui Xian; they memorialized Xian and Cui Jishu's faults and crimes—two hundred lashes and exile to the frontier.

sentences.zh: 侯景以宋子仙為司徙、郭元建為尚書左僕射，與領軍任約等四十人並開府儀同三司，仍詔：「自今開府儀同不須更加將軍。

translations.literal: Hou Jing made Song Zixian Minister of Works and Guo Yuanjian Left Vice Director of the Secretariat; with Army Commander Ren Yue and forty others he all made Equal in Honor to the Three Dukes with independent staffs, and also decreed: "From now on, Equal in Honor to the Three Dukes need not additionally receive general's rank.
translations.idiomatic: Hou Jing made Song Zixian minister of works and Guo Yuanjian left vice director of the secretariat; with army commander Ren Yue and forty others he all made equal in honor to the three dukes with independent staffs, and also decreed: "From now on, equal in honor to the three dukes need not additionally receive general's rank.

sentences.zh: 」是後開府儀同至多，不可復記矣。

translations.literal: " After this, those made Equal in Honor to the Three Dukes became so numerous they could no longer be recorded.
translations.idiomatic: " After this, those made equal in honor to the three dukes became so numerous they could no longer be recorded.

sentences.zh: 鄱陽王范自樅陽遣信告江州刺史尋陽王大心，大心遣信邀之。

translations.literal: Prince of Poyang Fan sent a message from Zongyang to inform Jiangzhou Inspector Prince of Xunyang Daxin; Daxin sent a message inviting him.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Xiao Fan of Poyang sent a message from Zongyang to inform Jiangzhou inspector Prince Daxin of Xunyang; Daxin sent a message inviting him.

sentences.zh: 范引兵詣江州，大心以湓城處之。

translations.literal: Fan led his troops to Jiangzhou; Daxin lodged him at Pencheng.
translations.idiomatic: Fan led his troops to Jiangzhou; Daxin lodged him at Pencheng.

sentences.zh: 吳興兵力寡弱，張嵊書生，不閒軍旅。

translations.literal: Wuxing's military strength was thin and weak; Zhang Sheng was a bookish man, unskilled in military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Wuxing's military strength was thin and weak; Zhang Sheng was a bookish man, unskilled in military affairs.

sentences.zh: 或勸嵊效袁君正以郡迎侯子鑒。

translations.literal: Some urged Sheng to follow Yuan Junzheng's example and welcome Hou Zijian with the commandery.
translations.idiomatic: Some urged Sheng to follow Yuan Junzheng's example and welcome Hou Zijian with the commandery.

sentences.zh: 嵊歎曰：「袁氏世濟忠貞，不意君正一旦隳之。

translations.literal: Sheng sighed and said, "The Yuan clan for generations upheld loyalty and integrity—I did not expect Junzheng to ruin it in a single day.
translations.idiomatic: Sheng sighed and said, "The Yuan clan for generations upheld loyalty and integrity—I did not expect Junzheng to ruin it in a single day.

sentences.zh: 吾豈不知吳郡既沒，吳興勢難久全；

translations.literal: Do I not know that once Wu Commandery has fallen, Wuxing can hardly long endure;
translations.idiomatic: Do I not know that once Wu Commandery has fallen, Wuxing can hardly long endure;

sentences.zh: 但以身許國，有死無貳耳！

translations.literal: but having pledged my body to the state, I have death and no second loyalty!
translations.idiomatic: but having pledged my body to the state, I have death and no second loyalty!

sentences.zh: 」九月，癸丑朔，子鑒軍至吳興，嵊戰敗，還府，整服安坐，子鑒執送建康。

translations.literal: " In the ninth month, on the first day guichou, Zijian's army reached Wuxing; Sheng was defeated in battle, returned to his headquarters, dressed properly and sat at ease; Zijian seized him and sent him to Jiankang.
translations.idiomatic: " In the ninth month, on the first day guichou, Zijian's army reached Wuxing; Sheng was defeated, returned to his headquarters, dressed properly and sat at ease; Zijian seized him and sent him to Jiankang.

sentences.zh: 侯景嘉其守節，欲活之，嵊曰：「吾忝任專城，朝廷傾危，不能匡復，今日速死為幸！

translations.literal: Hou Jing admired his steadfast integrity and wished to spare him; Sheng said, "I disgracefully held a walled city alone; the court totters and I could not restore it—quick death today is fortune!
translations.idiomatic: Hou Jing admired his steadfast integrity and wished to spare him; Sheng said, "I disgracefully held a walled city alone; the court totters and I could not restore it—quick death today is fortune!

sentences.zh: 」景猶欲存其一子，嵊曰：「吾一門已在鬼錄，不就爾虜求恩！

translations.literal: " Jing still wished to spare one of his sons; Sheng said, "My whole house is already on the roll of ghosts—I will not beg favor from you rebels!
translations.idiomatic: " Jing still wished to spare one of his sons; Sheng said, "My whole house is already on the roll of ghosts—I will not beg favor from you rebels!

sentences.zh: 」景怒，盡殺之；

translations.literal: " Jing in anger killed them all;
translations.idiomatic: " Jing in anger killed them all;

sentences.zh: 並殺沈浚。

translations.literal: and also killed Shen Jun.
translations.idiomatic: and also killed Shen Jun.

sentences.zh: 河東王譽告急於岳陽王察，察留咨議參軍濟陽蔡大寶守襄陽，帥眾二萬、騎二千伐江陵以救湘州。

translations.literal: Prince of Hedong Yu urgently reported to Prince of Yueyang Cha; Cha left advisory staff officer Cai Dabao of Jiyang to hold Xiangyang and led twenty thousand men and two thousand horse to attack Jiangling to save Xiang Province.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Xiao Yu of Hedong urgently reported to Prince Xiao Cha of Yueyang; Cha left advisory staff officer Cai Dabao of Jiyang to hold Xiangyang and led twenty thousand men and two thousand cavalry to attack Jiangling to save Xiang Province.

sentences.zh: 湘東王繹大懼，遣左右就獄中問計於王僧辯，僧辯具陳方略，繹乃赦之，以為城中都督。

translations.literal: Prince of Xiangdong Yi was greatly afraid; he sent attendants to the prison to ask Wang Senbian for counsel; Senbian fully set forth his strategy; Yi then pardoned him and made him commander within the city.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Xiao Yi of Xiangdong was greatly afraid; he sent attendants to the prison to ask Wang Senbian for counsel; Senbian fully set forth his strategy; Yi then pardoned him and made him commander within the city.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，察至江陵，作十三營以攻之；

translations.literal: On yimao, Cha reached Jiangling and built thirteen camps to attack it;
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, Cha reached Jiangling and built thirteen camps to attack it;

sentences.zh: 會大雨，平地水深四尺，察軍氣沮。

translations.literal: it happened to rain heavily; water on level ground was four chi deep, and Cha's army's morale sank.
translations.idiomatic: it happened to rain heavily; water on level ground was four chi deep, and Cha's army's morale sank.

sentences.zh: 繹與新興太守杜崱有舊，密邀之。

translations.literal: Yi had old ties with Xinxing prefect Du Ya and secretly invited him.
translations.idiomatic: Yi had old ties with Xinxing prefect Du Ya and secretly invited him.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，崱與兄岌、岸、弟幼安、兄子龕各帥所部降於繹。

translations.literal: On yichou, Ya, his elder brothers Ji and An, his younger brother You'an, and his elder brother's son Kan each led their units to surrender to Yi.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, Ya, his elder brothers Ji and An, his younger brother You'an, and his elder brother's son Kan each led their units to surrender to Yi.

sentences.zh: 岸請以五百騎襲襄陽，晝夜兼行，去襄陽三十里，城中覺之，蔡大寶奉察母龔保林登城拒戰。

translations.literal: An asked to take five hundred horse in a surprise attack on Xiangyang, traveling day and night by double stages; thirty li from Xiangyang the city detected them; Cai Dabao supported Cha's mother Gong Baolin in ascending the wall to resist.
translations.idiomatic: An asked to take five hundred cavalry in a surprise attack on Xiangyang, traveling day and night by double stages; thirty li from Xiangyang the city detected them; Cai Dabao supported Cha's mother Gong Baolin in ascending the wall to resist.

sentences.zh: 察聞之，夜遁，棄糧食、金帛、鎧仗於湕水，不可勝紀。

translations.literal: Cha heard of it and fled by night, abandoning grain, gold, silk, armor, and weapons at the Ju River beyond counting.
translations.idiomatic: Cha heard of it and fled by night, abandoning grain, gold, silk, armor, and weapons at the Ju River beyond counting.

sentences.zh: 張纘病足，察載以隨軍；

translations.literal: Zhang Zuan was ill in the foot; Cha carried him along with the army;
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Zuan was ill in the foot; Cha carried him along with the army;

sentences.zh: 及敗走，守者恐為追兵所及，殺之，棄屍而去。

translations.literal: when they were defeated and fled, the guards feared pursuit and killed him, leaving the corpse and going.
translations.idiomatic: when they were defeated and fled, the guards feared pursuit and killed him, leaving the corpse and going.

sentences.zh: 察至襄陽，岸奔廣平，依其兄南陽太守□獻。

translations.literal: Cha reached Xiangyang; An fled to Guangping and relied on his elder brother, Nanyang prefect [Xian].
translations.idiomatic: Cha reached Xiangyang; An fled to Guangping and relied on his elder brother, Nanyang prefect [Xian].

sentences.zh: 湘東王繹以鮑泉圍長沙久不克，怒之，以平南將軍王僧辯代為都督，數泉十罪，命舍人羅重歡與僧辯偕行。

translations.literal: Prince of Xiangdong Yi, because Bao Quan besieged Changsha long without taking it, was angry; he replaced him with Pingnan General Wang Senbian as commander, counted ten crimes against Quan, and ordered Gentleman-Attendant Luo Chonghuan to go with Senbian.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Xiao Yi of Xiangdong, because Bao Quan besieged Changsha long without taking it, was angry; he replaced him with pingnan general Wang Senbian as commander, counted ten crimes against Quan, and ordered gentleman-attendant Luo Chonghuan to go with Senbian.

sentences.zh: 泉聞僧辯來，愕然曰：「得王竟陵來助我，賊不足平。

translations.literal: Quan heard Senbian was coming and said in astonishment, "To get Wang of Jingling to help me—the rebels are not worth crushing.
translations.idiomatic: Quan heard Senbian was coming and said in astonishment, "To get Wang of Jingling to help me—the rebels are not worth crushing.

sentences.zh: 」拂席待之。

translations.literal: " He brushed the mat and awaited him.
translations.idiomatic: " He brushed the mat and awaited him.

sentences.zh: 僧辯入，背泉而坐，曰：「鮑郎，卿有罪，令旨使我鎖卿，卿勿以故意見期。

translations.literal: Senbian entered, sat with his back to Quan, and said, "Master Bao, you are guilty; by order I am to fetter you—do not expect our old friendship.
translations.idiomatic: Senbian entered, sat with his back to Quan, and said, "Master Bao, you are guilty; by order I am to fetter you—do not expect our old friendship.

sentences.zh: 」使重歡宣令，鎖之床側。

translations.literal: " He had Chonghuan proclaim the order and fettered him beside the bed.
translations.idiomatic: " He had Chonghuan proclaim the order and fettered him beside the bed.

sentences.zh: 泉為啟自申，且謝淹緩之罪，繹怒解，遂釋之。

translations.literal: Quan submitted a memorial in his own defense and also apologized for the delay; Yi's anger eased, and he was released.
translations.idiomatic: Quan submitted a memorial in his own defense and also apologized for the delay; Yi's anger eased, and he was released.

sentences.zh: 冬，十月，癸未朔，東魏以開府儀同三司潘相樂為司空。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on the first day guiwei, Eastern Wei made Equal in Honor to the Three Dukes Pan Xiangle Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, the tenth month, on the first day guiwei, Eastern Wei made Pan Xiangle, equal in honor to the three dukes, minister of works.

sentences.zh: 初，歷陽太守莊鐵帥眾歸尋陽王大心，大心以為豫章內史。

translations.literal: Earlier, Liyang prefect Zhuang Tie led his troops to submit to Prince of Xunyang Daxin; Daxin made him Administrator of Yuzhang.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, Liyang prefect Zhuang Tie led his troops to submit to Prince Daxin of Xunyang; Daxin made him administrator of Yuzhang.

sentences.zh: 鐵至郡即叛，推觀寧侯永為主。

translations.literal: Tie reached the commandery and immediately rebelled, setting up Marquis of Guanning Yong as leader.
translations.idiomatic: Tie reached the commandery and immediately rebelled, setting up Marquis Yong of Guanning as leader.

sentences.zh: 永，范之弟也。

translations.literal: Yong was Fan's younger brother.
translations.idiomatic: Yong was Fan's younger brother.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，鐵引兵襲尋陽，大心遣其將徐嗣徽逆擊，破之。

translations.literal: On dingyou, Tie led troops in a surprise attack on Xunyang; Daxin sent his general Xu Sihui to meet and strike him and defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, Tie led troops in a surprise attack on Xunyang; Daxin sent his general Xu Sihui to meet and strike him and defeated him.

sentences.zh: 鐵走，至建昌，光遠將軍韋構邀擊之，鐵失其母弟妻子，單騎還南昌，大心遣構將兵追討之。

translations.literal: Tie fled; reaching Jianchang, Guangyuan General Wei Gou intercepted and struck him; Tie lost his mother, younger brother, wife, and children, returned alone on horseback to Nanchang; Daxin sent Gou leading troops in pursuit.
translations.idiomatic: Tie fled; reaching Jianchang, guangyuan general Wei Gou intercepted and struck him; Tie lost his mother, younger brother, wife, and children, returned alone on horseback to Nanchang; Daxin sent Gou leading troops in pursuit.

sentences.zh: 宋子仙自吳郡趣錢塘。

translations.literal: Song Zixian from Wu Commandery pressed toward Qiantang.
translations.idiomatic: Song Zixian marched from Wu Commandery toward Qiantang.

sentences.zh: 劉神茂自吳興趣富陽，前武州刺史富陽孫國恩以城降之。

translations.literal: Liu Shenmao from Wuxing pressed toward Fuyang; former Wuzhou Inspector Sun Guo'en of Fuyang surrendered the city to him.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Shenmao marched from Wuxing toward Fuyang; former Wuzhou inspector Sun Guo'en of Fuyang surrendered the city to him.

sentences.zh: 十一月，乙卯，葬武皇帝於修陵，廟號高祖。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on yimao, the Martial Emperor was buried at Xiuling; his temple name was Gaozu.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on yimao, the Martial Emperor was buried at Xiuling; his temple name was Gaozu.

sentences.zh: 百濟遣使入貢，見城闕荒圮，異於向來，哭於端門；

translations.literal: Baekje sent envoys to pay tribute; seeing the city gates ruined and desolate, unlike before, they wept at the Duan Gate;
translations.idiomatic: Baekje sent envoys to pay tribute; seeing the city gates ruined and desolate, unlike before, they wept at the Duan Gate;

sentences.zh: 侯景怒，錄送莊嚴寺，不聽出。

translations.literal: Hou Jing was angry, seized them and sent them to Zhuangyan Temple, and would not let them leave.
translations.idiomatic: Hou Jing was angry, seized them and sent them to Zhuangyan Temple, and would not let them leave.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，宋子仙急攻錢塘，戴僧逖降之。

translations.literal: On renxu, Song Zixian pressed the attack on Qiantang; Dai Sengti surrendered to him.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, Song Zixian pressed the attack on Qiantang; Dai Sengti surrendered to him.

sentences.zh: 岳陽王察使將軍薛暉攻廣平，拔之，獲杜岸，送襄陽。

translations.literal: Prince of Yueyang Cha sent General Xue Hui to attack Guangping, took it, captured Du An, and sent him to Xiangyang.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Xiao Cha of Yueyang sent general Xue Hui to attack Guangping, took it, captured Du An, and sent him to Xiangyang.

sentences.zh: 察拔其舌，鞭其面，支解而烹之。

translations.literal: Cha pulled out his tongue, whipped his face, dismembered him, and boiled him.
translations.idiomatic: Cha pulled out his tongue, whipped his face, dismembered him, and boiled him.

sentences.zh: 又發其祖父墓，焚其骸而揚之，以其頭為漆碗。

translations.literal: He also opened his grandfather's tomb, burned the bones and scattered the ashes, and made his skull into a lacquered bowl.
translations.idiomatic: He also opened his grandfather's tomb, burned the bones and scattered the ashes, and made his skull into a lacquered bowl.

sentences.zh: 察既與湘東王繹為敵，恐不能自存，遣使求援於魏，請為附庸。

translations.literal: Cha, now enemy to Prince of Xiangdong Yi, feared he could not survive alone; he sent envoys to Wei to beg aid and asked to become a vassal.
translations.idiomatic: Cha, now enemy to Prince Xiao Yi of Xiangdong, feared he could not survive alone; he sent envoys to Western Wei to beg aid and asked to become a vassal.

sentences.zh: 丞相泰令東閣祭酒榮權使於襄陽。

translations.literal: Chancellor Tai sent Eastern Pavilion Libationer Rong Quan as envoy to Xiangyang.
translations.idiomatic: Chancellor Yuwen Tai sent eastern pavilion libationer Rong Quan as envoy to Xiangyang.

sentences.zh: 繹使司州刺史柳仲禮鎮竟陵以圖察，察懼，遣其妃王氏及世子察為質於魏。

translations.literal: Yi sent Sizhou Inspector Liu Zhongli to hold Jingling to plot against Cha; Cha was afraid and sent his consort Lady Wang and his heir Cha as hostages to Wei.
translations.idiomatic: Yi sent Sizhou inspector Liu Zhongli to hold Jingling to plot against Cha; Cha was afraid and sent his consort Lady Wang and his heir Cha as hostages to Western Wei.

sentences.zh: 丞相泰欲經略江、漢，以開府儀同三司楊忠都督三荊等十五州諸軍事，鎮穰城。

translations.literal: Chancellor Tai wished to extend control over the Yangtze and Han; he made Equal in Honor to the Three Dukes Yang Zhong commander of all military affairs in the Three Jing and fifteen other provinces, stationed at Rangcheng.
translations.idiomatic: Chancellor Yuwen Tai wished to extend control over the Yangtze and Han; he made Yang Zhong, equal in honor to the three dukes, commander of all military affairs in the Three Jing and fifteen other provinces, stationed at Rangcheng.

sentences.zh: 仲禮至安陸，安陸太守沈勰以城降之。

translations.literal: Zhongli reached Anlu; Anlu prefect Shen Ji surrendered the city to him.
translations.idiomatic: Zhongli reached Anlu; Anlu prefect Shen Ji surrendered the city to him.

sentences.zh: 仲禮留長史馬岫與其弟子禮守之，帥眾一萬趣襄陽，泰遣楊忠及行台僕射長孫儉將兵擊仲禮以救察。

translations.literal: Zhongli left Chief Clerk Ma Xiu and his younger brother Zili to hold it, led ten thousand men toward Xiangyang; Tai sent Yang Zhong and Mobile Secretariat Vice Director Changsun Jian leading troops to strike Zhongli and save Cha.
translations.idiomatic: Zhongli left chief clerk Ma Xiu and his younger brother Zili to hold it, led ten thousand men toward Xiangyang; Yuwen Tai sent Yang Zhong and mobile secretariat vice director Changsun Jian with troops to strike Zhongli and save Cha.

sentences.zh: 宋子仙乘勝度浙江，至會稽。

translations.literal: Song Zixian pressed the victory across the Zhe River and reached Kuaiji.
translations.idiomatic: Song Zixian pressed the victory across the Zhe River and reached Kuaiji.

sentences.zh: 邵陵王綸聞錢塘已敗，出奔鄱陽，鄱陽內史開建侯蕃以兵拒之，范進擊蕃，破之。

translations.literal: Prince of Shaoling Lun heard Qiantang had fallen, fled toward Poyang; Poyang Administrator Marquis of Kaijian Fan resisted with troops; Prince of Poyang Fan advanced and struck Fan and defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Xiao Lun of Shaoling heard Qiantang had fallen and fled toward Poyang; Poyang administrator Marquis Fan of Kaijian resisted with troops; Prince Xiao Fan of Poyang advanced, struck Fan, and defeated him.

sentences.zh: 魏楊忠將至義陽，太守馬伯符以下溠城降之，忠以伯符為鄉導。

translations.literal: Wei's Yang Zhong was about to reach Yiyang; prefect Ma Bofu below Xiachuan surrendered the city to him; Zhong made Bofu his guide.
translations.idiomatic: Western Wei's Yang Zhong was about to reach Yiyang; prefect Ma Bofu below Xiachuan surrendered the city to him; Zhong made Bofu his guide.

sentences.zh: 伯符，岫之子也。

translations.literal: Bofu was Xiu's son.
translations.idiomatic: Bofu was Xiu's son.

sentences.zh: 南郡王大連為東揚州刺史。

translations.literal: Prince of Nanjun Dalian was made Eastern Yangzhou Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Dalian of Nanjun was made Eastern Yangzhou inspector.

sentences.zh: 時會稽豐沃，勝兵數萬，糧仗山積，東人懲侯景殘虐，鹹樂為用，而大連朝夕酣飲，不恤軍事；

translations.literal: At the time Kuaiji was rich and fertile, with tens of thousands of fit soldiers and grain and arms piled like mountains; the eastern people, chastened by Hou Jing's cruelty, all gladly served—yet Dalian drank day and night and did not care for military affairs;
translations.idiomatic: At the time Kuaiji was rich and fertile, with tens of thousands of fit soldiers and grain and arms piled like mountains; the eastern people, chastened by Hou Jing's cruelty, all gladly served—yet Dalian drank day and night and did not care for military affairs;

sentences.zh: 司馬東陽留異，凶狡殘暴，為眾所患，大連悉以軍事委之。

translations.literal: Eastern Yangzhou staff officer Liu Yi was fierce, cunning, and cruel, hated by all; Dalian entrusted all military affairs to him.
translations.idiomatic: Eastern Yangzhou staff officer Liu Yi was fierce, cunning, and cruel, hated by all; Dalian entrusted all military affairs to him.

sentences.zh: 十二月，庚寅，宋子仙攻會稽，大連棄城走，異奔還鄉里，尋以其眾降於子仙。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on gengyin, Song Zixian attacked Kuaiji; Dalian abandoned the city and fled; Yi fled back to his home village, and soon surrendered his troops to Zixian.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on gengyin, Song Zixian attacked Kuaiji; Dalian abandoned the city and fled; Yi fled back to his home village, and soon surrendered his troops to Zixian.

sentences.zh: 大連欲奔鄱陽，異為子仙鄉導，追及大連於信安，執送建康，大連猶醉不之知。

translations.literal: Dalian wished to flee to Poyang; Yi served as Zixian's guide, overtook Dalian at Xin'an, seized him and sent him to Jiankang—Dalian was still drunk and knew nothing of it.
translations.idiomatic: Dalian wished to flee to Poyang; Yi served as Zixian's guide, overtook Dalian at Xin'an, seized him and sent him to Jiankang—Dalian was still drunk and knew nothing of it.

sentences.zh: 帝聞之，引帷自蔽，掩袂而泣。

translations.literal: The emperor heard of it, drew the curtain to hide himself, and wept into his sleeve.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor heard of it, drew the curtain to hide himself, and wept into his sleeve.

sentences.zh: 於是三吳盡沒於景，公侯在會稽者，俱南度嶺。

translations.literal: Thereupon the Three Wu regions all fell to Jing; nobles who had been at Kuaiji all crossed the mountains southward.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon the Three Wu regions all fell to Jing; nobles who had been at Kuaiji all crossed the mountains southward.

sentences.zh: 景以留異為東陽太守，收其妻子為質。

translations.literal: Jing made Liu Yi Administrator of Dongyang and took his wife and children as hostages.
translations.idiomatic: Jing made Liu Yi administrator of Dongyang and took his wife and children as hostages.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，東魏以并州刺史彭樂為司徒。

translations.literal: On yiyou, Eastern Wei made Bingzhou Inspector Peng Yue Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, Eastern Wei made Bingzhou inspector Peng Yue minister of works.

sentences.zh: 邵陵王綸進至九江，尋陽王大心以江州讓之，綸不受，引兵西上。

translations.literal: Prince of Shaoling Lun advanced to Jiujiang; Prince of Xunyang Daxin offered Jiangzhou to him; Lun did not accept and led his troops westward.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Xiao Lun of Shaoling advanced to Jiujiang; Prince Daxin of Xunyang offered Jiangzhou to him; Lun did not accept and led his troops westward.

sentences.zh: 始興太守陳霸先結郡中豪傑欲討侯景，郡人侯安都、張人思等各帥眾千餘人歸之。

translations.literal: Shixing prefect Chen Baxian rallied the commandery's leading men to attack Hou Jing; commandery men Hou Andu, Zhang Rensi, and others each led more than a thousand men to join him.
translations.idiomatic: Shixing prefect Chen Baxian rallied the commandery's leading men to attack Hou Jing; commandery men Hou Andu, Zhang Rensi, and others each led more than a thousand men to join him.

sentences.zh: 霸先遣主帥杜僧明將二千人頓於嶺上，廣州刺史蕭勃遣人止之曰：「侯景驍雄，天下無敵，前者援軍十萬，士馬精強，猶不能克，君以區區之眾，將何所之！

translations.literal: Baxian sent commander Du Sengming with two thousand men to encamp on the ridge; Guangzhou Inspector Xiao Bo sent someone to stop him, saying, "Hou Jing is fierce and heroic, matchless under heaven; the earlier relief army of a hundred thousand with keen men and horses still could not defeat him—with your paltry force, where will you go!
translations.idiomatic: Baxian sent commander Du Sengming with two thousand men to encamp on the ridge; Guangzhou inspector Xiao Bo sent someone to stop him, saying, "Hou Jing is fierce and heroic, matchless under heaven; the earlier relief army of a hundred thousand with keen men and horses still could not defeat him—with your paltry force, where will you go!

sentences.zh: 如聞嶺北王侯又皆鼎沸，親尋干戈，以君疏外，詎可暗投！

translations.literal: I hear the princes north of the ridge are all seething, seeking one another with weapons—for one of your distant station, how can you blindly throw yourself in!
translations.idiomatic: I hear the princes north of the ridge are all seething, seeking one another with weapons—for one of your distant station, how can you blindly throw yourself in!

sentences.zh: 未若且留始興，遙張聲勢，保太山之安也。

translations.literal: Better to stay at Shixing for now, raise a distant show of force, and keep the security of Mount Tai.
translations.idiomatic: Better to stay at Shixing for now, raise a distant show of force, and keep the security of Mount Tai.

sentences.zh: 」霸先曰：「僕荷國恩，往聞侯景度江，即欲赴援，遭值元、蘭，梗我中道。

translations.literal: " Baxian said, "I bear the state's grace; when I first heard Hou Jing crossed the river, I wished at once to go to aid; I met Yuan and Lan blocking my mid-course.
translations.idiomatic: " Baxian said, "I bear the state's grace; when I first heard Hou Jing crossed the river, I wished at once to go to aid; I met Yuan and Lan blocking my mid-course.

sentences.zh: 今京都覆沒，君辱臣死，誰敢愛命！

translations.literal: Now the capital has fallen; when the lord is shamed the minister dies—who dares cherish life!
translations.idiomatic: Now the capital has fallen; when the lord is shamed the minister dies—who dares cherish life!

sentences.zh: 君侯體則皇枝，任重方岳，遣僕一軍，猶賢乎已，乃更止之乎！

translations.literal: Your lordship by body is imperial branch, heavy with frontier responsibility—sending me one army is already more than I deserve, and now you would stop me!
translations.idiomatic: Your lordship by body is imperial branch, heavy with frontier responsibility—sending me one army is already more than I deserve, and now you would stop me!

sentences.zh: 」乃遣使間道詣江陵，受湘東王繹節度。

translations.literal: " He then sent envoys by hidden route to Jiangling to accept Prince of Xiangdong Yi's command.
translations.idiomatic: " He then sent envoys by hidden route to Jiangling to accept Prince Xiao Yi of Xiangdong's command.

sentences.zh: 時南康土豪蔡路養起兵據郡，勃乃以腹心譚世遠為曲江令，與路養相結，同遏霸先。

translations.literal: At the time the local strongman of Nankang, Cai Luyang, raised troops and seized the commandery; Bo then made his trusted man Tan Shiyuan magistrate of Qujiang, allied with Luyang, and together blocked Baxian.
translations.idiomatic: At the time the local strongman of Nankang, Cai Luyang, raised troops and seized the commandery; Bo then made his trusted man Tan Shiyuan magistrate of Qujiang, allied with Luyang, and together blocked Baxian.

sentences.zh: 魏楊忠拔隨郡，執太守桓和。

translations.literal: Wei's Yang Zhong took Suicheng and seized prefect Huan He.
translations.idiomatic: Western Wei's Yang Zhong took Suicheng and seized prefect Huan He.

sentences.zh: 東魏使金門公潘樂等將兵五萬襲司州，刺史夏侯強降之。

translations.literal: Eastern Wei sent Prince of Jinmen Pan Yue and others leading fifty thousand troops in a surprise attack on Sizhou; Inspector Xiahou Qiang surrendered to them.
translations.idiomatic: Eastern Wei sent Prince Pan Yue of Jinmen and others with fifty thousand troops in a surprise attack on Sizhou; inspector Xiahou Qiang surrendered to them.

sentences.zh: 於是東魏盡有淮南之地。

translations.literal: Thereupon Eastern Wei possessed all the land south of the Huai.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon Eastern Wei possessed all the land south of the Huai.
